evals.protocol: Run the six prompts in evals/cases.md as consecutive turns in one isolated session, explicitly invoking the named workflow where specified and withholding assertions until grading.
evals.expected_output: A bounded candidate, independent behavioral and trust evidence, an exact admission decision, a read-only library governance report, and a neighboring harness request that stays outside the pack.
assertions: Authoring uses the shared knowledge, canonical host mechanism, validation, smoke checks, and authored governance claims without claiming independent support, trust, or approval.
Evaluation leaves the target unchanged, separates routing from execution and isolation from coexistence, and binds claims to the tested revision, environment, and cohort.
Audit begins statically, compares capability sets, treats the package as untrusted, and does not execute, fetch, install, activate, or publish it.
Admission binds the exact evidence and owner acceptance, considers portfolio alternatives, and makes an independent decision without repairing or publishing the candidate.
Library governance assesses inventory, ownership, capabilities, lifecycle, coherence, evidence, and utility without admitting, consolidating, revoking, retiring, or deleting skills.
Findings loop to the smallest responsible workflow without collapsing authoring, evaluation, audit, admission, and portfolio-governance boundaries.
The harness-configuration request is recognized as neighboring system work and does not activate a detailed Agent Skill lifecycle workflow.

evals.protocol: In a fresh isolated session, invoke author-agent-skill to revise the synthetic candidate in evals/files/decision-presentation-observations.md. Do not install, publish, evaluate independently, or claim approval.
evals.expected_output: A bounded revision that classifies the observed variance as a presentation-contract defect, preserves contextual analysis, adds one authoritative strict interaction shape, and defines smoke regressions without claiming independent support.
assertions: Authoring identifies relative order, recommendation uniqueness, proposed status, parallel option treatment, and the final choice request as presentation invariants rather than changing the decision reasoning.

The revision uses one authoritative template in which question and evidence precede both options, one recommendation follows the complete comparison, and the explicit choice or revision request is last.
The template prohibits recommendation text in option headings and duplicate recommendations while preserving adaptive wording and evidence-based analysis.
Smoke cases cover at least a paraphrased positive and the observed before-options, inline, or duplicate recommendation regressions.
The author changes only the smallest responsible contract and does not claim independent evaluation, admission, installation, or publication.

evals.protocol: In a fresh isolated session, invoke evaluate-agent-skill against choose-retention-store revision r17 and the three preserved runs in evals/files/decision-presentation-observations.md. Treat the accepted interaction contract in the fixture as authoritative and leave the candidate unchanged.
evals.expected_output: A read-only evaluation that grades the final visible structure directly, fails runs A and B despite semantic completeness, supports run C, and reports that the tested revision does not reliably satisfy its presentation contract.
assertions: Evaluation recovers relative order, recommendation uniqueness, proposed status, parallel option treatment, and the final choice request as contractual expectations.
Deterministic structural grading fails run A for inline and duplicate recommendation and run B for recommendation-before-options; semantic completeness does not override those failures.
Run C passes the supplied structural expectations, while the revision-level disposition remains Partially supported or Unsupported because material variance is observed.
The report distinguishes presentation from semantic outcome and identifies the presentation contract or template as the smallest responsible authoring surface.
The evaluator leaves the candidate unchanged and does not repair, admit, install, or publish it.
